lid.scope: Exact lid geometry and local contact only; no body integration, native slicing or physical testing.

load_paths.contact_method: Opposing original BRep faces on each specified stack plane, clipped to the local diameter15 screw footprint.
load_paths.scope: Positive contact area proves a nominal continuous clamp path only. It does not establish nylon bearing strength, creep resistance or tightening torque.

baseline_delta.scope: Six sheets, twelve body nylon parts, two front/back lid middle spans and six revised lid nylon parts: exact STEP/BRep differences in the saved assembly datum. Sixteen stock brackets, 216 retained fastener/washer items and four feet: exact candidate bounds versus saved R11-03 bounds plus rounded volume/one-solid checks; this is an envelope invariant, not a baseline BRep equality claim.

access.assembly_note: Omit the 32 old inside washers at metal-bracketed sites; retain all eight top inside washers. Integral wall/floor L cheeks and corner returns must be offered to the sheets before clamping; fit wall nuts before the perpendicular floor nuts and install the independent rail unit last. Start all shared-joint screws loosely before final tightening. This sequence is a CAD-based proposal, not a physically demonstrated assembly.
access.tool_scope: D10/D12 cylinders are hypothetical axial tool-clearance probes against nylon only. The actual socket/wrench geometry and access with modules installed are unknown. Obstructed probes are reported, not disguised as a generic tool-fit pass; original-frame clearance and perpendicular-nut checks remain in reference_check.py.
access.top_bearing_scope: The eight top nuts retain their round inside washers. Ear-to-washer and washer-to-nut areas at both travel endpoints and the nominal centre are reported; positive area alone is not a bearing-strength or torque approval.

inner_ear_review.scope: Focused nominal CAD evidence for integral inside ears. Full component collisions, lid checks and original rail-frame clearances are separate checks in the same build. No physical assembly, material-strength or manufacturing approval is claimed.

guides.scope: Original guide faces and exact BRep sections below the seating plane; probe volumes confirm continuous 12 mm engagement away from designed seams and reliefs. Clearance is geometric, not manufacturing fit.

straight_lift_off.scope: Continuous straight +Z union sweep, reversible for lowering; lower frame solids plus all upward planar-face extrusions. Exact nominal body and 60 source solids, conservative boxes for six rails, plus full upper nut/washer adjustment envelopes. No tilted removal, tool access, tolerances or physical fit qualification.

lid_locator_review.scope: Nominal geometry only; additional lateral guidance does not establish a durability, strength or transport-retention rating.
